summary: Soccer Goal Scorer (Phase B.1) simulator end-to-end verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass — ATGS schema (sim_market_category='scorer_atgs', sim_runs=10000, sim_player_xg, sim_p_score_2plus, sim_p_hattrick), λ-to-model_wp calibration within ±3pp on healthy WPs (Oyarzabal 49.4→48.9, Messi 53.3→52.2), key_insights regex parsers (Yildiz: xG/match 0.73 + shots 4.0 parsed; Nygren: recent_goal_rate 50%; Uzun: shots+recent), anomalous low-WP picks (Uzun/Yildiz/Nygren — model_wp=1%) all produce stronger signal with disagreement +48–+62pp as designed, non-scorer Soccer (Total Goals Over 2.5) correctly routes to team Poisson with cat='totals'+λ_pick/λ_opp, MLB/NBA/Tennis regression still passes. Frontend: SimulatorPanel correctly renders scorer-specific extras row (λ XG / 2+ GOALS / HAT-TRICK) and scorer-specific footnote ('Player-level Poisson goalscorer model…') for ATGS picks; renders team-level extras (λ PICK / λ OPP / MARKET) and team-level footnote for non-scorer Soccer markets; the STRONGER-THAN-MODEL signal pill correctly surfaces on the anomalous Yildiz pick (DELTA +48.6). One stale Metro bundle initially served old extras row — resolved by `supervisorctl restart expo`. No red screens. No new RN warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: sim_soccer_scorer.py routing is clean — _classify_scorer_market correctly distinguishes ATGS / FGS / LGS / two_plus / hattrick. The 'to score' generic fallback at line 116 correctly catches markets like 'Mikel Oyarzabal Anytime Goal Scorer' even when 'anytime' isn't separately matched.

_estimate_player_lambda implements 3 fallback layers (model_wp calibration → key_insights priors → factor-based heuristic). Calibration via λ = -ln(1-p) is mathematically sound for ATGS (P(Poisson(λ)≥1) = 1 - e^-λ). For 2+/hat-trick markets, bisection (_bisect_lambda_for_atleast_k) correctly inverts the Poisson CDF.

Gamma-Poisson hierarchical sampling (line 253: random.gammavariate(alpha, lam/alpha)) gives parameter uncertainty without over-inflating runs — alpha=max(2.0, n_obs) defaults to 10 obs which matches the 'last 10 matches' insights cadence. Resulting CI half-width on Oyarzabal pick is ±1pp at 10k runs, which is reasonable.

FGS/LGS heuristic (line 273: wins = int(hits / 3)) is a coarse approximation — 'P(scores first) ≈ P(scores)/3'. Documented limitation; main agent should consider richer per-team scoring distribution later, but acceptable for v1.

sim_soccer.py routes scorer markets to sim_soccer_scorer at line 152 BEFORE running team Poisson — ensures no stale lambda_pick/lambda_opp leak into scorer sim output. Correctly verified: ATGS pick output has sim_player_xg but no sim_lambda_pick; Totals pick has sim_lambda_pick but no sim_player_xg.

SimulatorPanel SportExtras branch on `typeof sim.sim_player_xg === 'number'` cleanly distinguishes scorer vs. team Poisson presentation. Footnote ternary on sim.sim_market_category?.startsWith?.('scorer') correctly switches between the two footnotes.

api.ts Pick type (line ~111-118) DOES include sim_player_xg/sim_p_score_2plus/sim_p_hattrick/sim_player_xg_per_game on the Pick interface — but the pickSimulation request<T> return type at line ~413 still has the legacy 8-field shape. Runtime works because TypeScript types are erased, but compile-time safety on the new scorer fields is lost (minor type hygiene).

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in the goal-scorer simulator itself. During initial frontend run, only the legacy 'MARKET' cell rendered on the ATGS pick because Metro was serving a stale cached bundle that pre-dated SimulatorPanel.tsx scorer-extras changes. After `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and waiting ~10s for Metro to rebundle, the full scorer-specific row (λ XG / 2+ GOALS / HAT-TRICK) and the scorer-specific footnote rendered correctly. Reproduction in production not expected since prod is a static build.
